screens.title: Today
screens.caption: Sourcing, sampling, T&A and inspections on one system — the merchandiser's morning is a short list, not seven spreadsheets.

screens.title: Styles & pricing
screens.caption: Every style that hits a mailbox is created with its tech pack; pricing runs on a 48-hour clock from receipt, benchmarked against similar confirmed styles.

screens.title: Sampling · 631KX
screens.caption: Sample rounds with the buyer's comments read from email, the SLA anchored to the buyer's ask date, and the next sample due date computed — not remembered.

screens.title: Orders & T&A · PO 4471
screens.caption: A time-and-action plan for every order, back-scheduled from the ship date across 28 stages, re-planned when a date moves — with skipped stages kept overdue until someone logs them.

screens.title: Inspections · PO 4459
screens.caption: Inspections logged on a phone at the factory: AQL sampling computed, defects photographed, pass/fail decided by the rule — and the report emailed to the buyer the same hour.

screens.title: Shipments
screens.caption: Handover, vessel, documents and the buyer's portal in one row per shipment — "on time" is judged at handover, which is the factory's clock, not the vessel's.

screens.title: Approvals
screens.caption: Plan-date changes, prices to buyers and invoices above PO wait for a named person. The AI shows the impact and recommends; a person decides.
